heroHeadline: Day 4,845: BTS Departs for Las Vegas, Headlines iHeartRadio Festival
heroSubtitle: September 18, 2026 is Day 4,845 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. All seven members — RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook — were photographed together departing Incheon International Airport on Sept 17, bound for Las Vegas where BTS headlines the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at T-Mobile Arena (Sept 18-19), streaming live on Disney+ and Hulu. Suga's appearance in the departure photos ended days of fan speculation over his whereabouts, after he stayed in Los Angeles rather than flying home with the rest of the group following the ARIRANG World Tour's SoFi Stadium finale (Sept 5-6). The tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2-3 before continuing to Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
